RagShortTexts: The Ormore trot is produced in the Ormore region of Sturgia. It has a strong body and outstanding endurance. It is adapted to the cold and rugged terrain of the North. It is a reliable partner for merchants on long journeys and lord messengers. It is also well received in the noble circle.

Variants.Content: The Ormore Trotter is produced in the Ormore region of Sturgia. It has a strong body shape and outstanding endurance. It is adapted to the cold climate and rugged terrain of the North. It is a reliable partner for Sturgian merchants on long journeys and for lord messengers to carry messages. It is also well received in noble circles.
